content.text: Start Building Wealth with Confidence

At InvestIQ, we make investing simple, personalized, and smarter for every investor. Our expertly designed portfolios are tailored to help you grow wealth, reduce risk, and reach your financial goals. Join thousands who trust InvestIQ to guide them toward financial independence with confidence.
Choose the Plan that Fits Your Journey

We offer three dynamic investment service tiers to meet every investor's needs. Discover the flexibility, insights, and exclusive benefits that come with each level, all supported by our commitment to smarter growth.
IQ Starter
Starting at $49/month
For New Investors Ready to Begin Building Wealth
Take your first step into investing with a stable, flexible plan designed to grow your wealth without high risk. Perfect for beginners and cautious investors looking for a solid start.
What’s Included:
Perfect For:
A diversified portfolio designed for reliable growth.
Quarterly updates on performance and market insights.
Access to exclusive workshops on financial wellness and investing basics.
New investors, students, or those wanting to start small with high-growth potential.
IQ Growth
Starting at $149/month
For Savvy Investors Ready to Amplify Their Returns
The Growth tier is designed for those aiming to strengthen and diversify their investments. Enjoy personalized portfolio adjustments and support to accelerate your financial journey.
What’s Included:
Perfect For:
Customized portfolio guidance that evolves with your goals.
Monthly performance reports with strategic insights.
Priority access to dedicated advisors for personalized support.
Invitations to member-only events with Q&A sessions and expert panels.
Intermediate investors seeking higher returns and a more involved investing experience.
IQ Elite
Starting at $499/month
For Strategic Investors Focused on Wealth Expansion

Our premier plan offers exclusive, high-touch service for ambitious investors. IQ Elite clients benefit from advanced market insights, strategy sessions, and continuous access to our top advisory team for optimal growth.
What’s Included:
Perfect For:
Bespoke portfolio design with quarterly reviews and adjustments.
Advanced monthly reports featuring market forecasts and growth strategies.
Unlimited one-on-one access to senior advisors.
Invitations to InvestIQ summits and exclusive networking events.
High-net-worth individuals and seasoned investors focused on achieving top-tier growth with expert support.
Why Choose InvestIQ?
With industry-leading experts, a commitment to transparency, and a focus on smarter investing, we empower you to make the most of your money. Here’s what sets InvestIQ apart:

Our fees are straightforward and transparent. No hidden costs—just clear, honest investing.
Secure and Compliant
We follow strict security protocols and meet all regulatory standards to keep your investments safe.
Personalized Guidance Every Step of the Way
From beginner to advanced, our advisors tailor support to your goals and investment style.
What Our Clients Are Saying
“InvestIQ made my first investing experience feel easy and secure. I started with IQ Starter and have already seen results that convinced me to upgrade. I’m excited for my future!”
— Emily R., IQ Starter Client

Ready to Begin Your IQ Journey?
Start building your wealth today. No matter where you are in your investment journey, InvestIQ has the right plan to support your goals.

<script>
  jQuery($ => {
    // The speed of the scroll in milliseconds
    const speed = 1000;

    $('a[href*="#"]')
      .filter((i, a) => a.getAttribute('href').startsWith('#') || a.href.startsWith(`${location.href}#`))
      .unbind('click.smoothScroll')
      .bind('click.smoothScroll', event => {
        const targetId = event.currentTarget.getAttribute('href').split('#')[1];
        const targetElement = document.getElementById(targetId);

        if (targetElement) {
          event.preventDefault();
          $('html, body').animate({ scrollTop: $(targetElement).offset().top }, speed);
        }
      });
  });
</script>
